resources.string: Couldn\'t reach that server. Check the address and try again.
This server is too old for the app. Ask your administrator to update it.
This server reports a different address than the one you entered. Enter the address it uses, or ask your administrator.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
That email, username or password doesn\'t match. Check them, or reset your password.
This sign-in step expired. Sign in again.
This reset link expired or was already used. Send a new link.
That code doesn\'t match. Check it and try again.
You canceled the sign-in before it finished. Try again when you\'re ready.
This sign-in attempt expired or was already used. Try again.
The provider\'s response couldn\'t be verified. Try again.
The provider rejected this sign-in attempt. Try again.
That sign-in provider is no longer available on this server. Use another sign-in method.
Couldn\'t read your profile from the provider. Try again.
The provider didn\'t share an email address, which is required. Allow email access when the provider asks, or use another sign-in method.
Your email address isn\'t verified with the provider. Verify it there, then try again.
That provider account uses a different email address than your account. Use a provider account with the same email address.
That provider account is already linked to another account. Use a different provider account.
Couldn\'t link that provider account. Try again.
This server isn\'t accepting new accounts. Sign in with an existing account.
This connection request is invalid or has expired. Start the connection again from your client.
The application that sent you here made an invalid authorization request. Return to the application and try again.
Couldn\'t sign you in. Try again.
